reason: The .vartype help said the integer/binary index lists are passed to the MPS writer; the code passes them only for the full problem (writeMatrix false or solverParams given) and the default writeMatrix true writes every variable as continuous. The matrix-only mode is a documented option, so the behaviour looks deliberate; the help now states it.
note: Borderline A/C: an MILP written by default loses its integrality; chosen A because the entry's EXPECTED asks for the help fix and 'writeMatrix' is documented as 'not the full problem'. The test's coverage exemption (quarantine, every line) refers to the remaining unusable-option entries. Note that 'writeMatrix' false given as the first option still fails (the other documented defect), so the help's 'writeMatrix false' route works only when it is not the first option.
